recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並呈細纖維條紋狀，像揉皺的衛生紙（crumpled tissue paper），細胞核小而偏位，是 Gaucher 細胞的典型特徵。
features: Large histiocyte many times the size of surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated (crumpled tissue paper) texture
Cytoplasm lacks discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbles
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors and lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm having a fine fibrillary, wrinkled texture and a small eccentric nucleus, set among maturing granulocytic and lymphoid cells. The cytoplasm is striated rather than vacuolated. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look identical and are distinguished by normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than fine linear striations.
